title: The Trick to Squaring Any Number Ending in 5
description: A quick shortcut for squaring numbers like 15, 25, or 35 in your head — no long multiplication needed.
narration_lines: Squaring a number that ends in 5? Try this.
Take the first digit, 3, and multiply it by one more than itself. 3 times 4 is 12.
Now just stick 25 on the end of that.

steps.label: Multiply the first digit by one more than itself

params.footnote: works for any number ending in 5
